title: Menu
description: An action menu opened from a button (Menu) or with a right click (ContextMenu): icons, shortcuts, separators, groups, checkbox items, radio groups, submenus, typeahead and full keyboard support (Enter, Space or ArrowDown open it on the first item, ArrowUp on the last; arrows wrap around and skip disabled items, Home / End, Tab closes it, Escape returns focus to the trigger). To pick a value from a list, use Select.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Items with icons and shortcut hints. onSelect receives the original item object, then the menu closes and focus returns to the trigger.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Any button can be the trigger, such as a Button or an IconButton; label icon-only triggers. Pass ariaLabel to name the menu panel.

groups.title: Groups, submenus and size
groups.description: Group entries with a label, separate them, and nest submenus with children. size="small" makes items denser; side and align position the panel.

submenus.title: Submenus
submenus.description: Nest entries with children. ArrowRight, Enter or Space open a submenu on its first item and ArrowLeft or Escape close it only; with the pointer, submenus open on hover and stay open while the pointer moves diagonally towards them. With dir="rtl" they open to the left and the arrow keys are swapped.

checkbox-radio.title: Checkbox and radio items
checkbox-radio.description: type: "checkbox" entries toggle (checked / defaultChecked + onCheckedChange) and type: "radio-group" entries hold mutually exclusive options (value / defaultValue + onValueChange). They keep the menu open so several options can be changed; set closeOnSelect on the entry to close it.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: side is the preferred side of the trigger and align the alignment against it; near the viewport edges the menu flips and shifts to stay visible.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disable individual items (they are skipped by the arrow keys) or the whole menu.

context-menu.title: Context menu
context-menu.description: ContextMenu opens the same entries at the pointer on right click or long press (a new right click moves it), and at the area with Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key. Focus moves to the first item and returns to the area on close.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Control the open state with open and onOpenChange; defaultOpen sets the initial state when it is uncontrolled.

MenuProps.children: Trigger element (button); click, Enter, Space and ArrowDown open the menu (ArrowUp focuses the last item)
MenuProps.onSelect: Called with the original item object when an action is selected
MenuProps.closeOnSelect: Whether selecting an action closes the menu (checkbox and radio items keep it open unless their entry sets closeOnSelect)
MenuProps.align: Alignment of the menu against the trigger
MenuProps.side: Preferred side; the menu flips when there is not enough room
MenuProps.open: Whether the menu is open (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)
MenuProps.onOpenChange: Called when the menu opens or closes
MenuProps.modal: Modal menus block pointer interaction outside, trap focus, lock scrolling and hide the rest of the page from assistive technologies while open
MenuProps.loop: Arrow keys wrap around from the last item to the first (and back)
MenuProps.dir: Reading direction: in "rtl" submenus open to the left and ArrowLeft / ArrowRight are swapped
MenuProps.className: Additional class name of the menu panel
MenuProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the menu panel (defaults to the trigger's label)

ContextMenuProps.children: Area that opens the menu on right click / long press / Shift+F10 / ContextMenu key
ContextMenuProps.onSelect: Called with the original item object when an action is selected
ContextMenuProps.closeOnSelect: Whether selecting an action closes the menu (checkbox and radio items keep it open unless their entry sets closeOnSelect)
ContextMenuProps.onOpenChange: Called when the menu opens or closes
ContextMenuProps.disabled: Disables the context menu (the native one shows instead)
ContextMenuProps.modal: Modal menus block pointer interaction outside, trap focus, lock scrolling and hide the rest of the page from assistive technologies while open
ContextMenuProps.loop: Arrow keys wrap around from the last item to the first (and back)
ContextMenuProps.dir: Reading direction: in "rtl" submenus open to the left and ArrowLeft / ArrowRight are swapped
ContextMenuProps.className: Additional class name of the menu panel
ContextMenuProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the menu panel

MenuAction.label: Content of the item
MenuAction.textValue: Text used for typeahead when label is not plain text
MenuAction.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut hint displayed after the label (display only)
MenuAction.closeOnSelect: Whether selecting this item closes the menu (overrides the menu's closeOnSelect)
MenuAction.children: Entries of a submenu opened by this item

MenuCheckboxEntry.label: Content of the item
MenuCheckboxEntry.textValue: Text used for typeahead when label is not plain text
MenuCheckboxEntry.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut hint displayed after the label (display only)
MenuCheckboxEntry.checked: Whether the item is checked (controlled; pair with onCheckedChange)
MenuCheckboxEntry.onCheckedChange: Called with the next checked state when the item is toggled
MenuCheckboxEntry.closeOnSelect: Whether toggling the item closes the menu

MenuRadioGroupEntry.label: Label displayed above the group (also names the group)
MenuRadioGroupEntry.onValueChange: Called with the value of the option that was chosen
MenuRadioGroupEntry.closeOnSelect: Whether choosing an option closes the menu

MenuRadioItem.value: Value of the option (unique within the group)
MenuRadioItem.label: Content of the option
MenuRadioItem.textValue: Text used for typeahead when label is not plain text
MenuRadioItem.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut hint displayed after the label (display only)
